scope: Polling uart_polling driver contract for mhz19b on ToBudOS/STM32F1 HAL. The fixed instance comes from task_requirements; include only HAL/timing operations actually used by the reference implementation and waits inside the main driver.

operations.name: HAL_UART_Transmit
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_UART_Transmit(UART_HandleTypeDef *, uint8_t *data, uint16_t size, uint32_t timeout)

operations.name: HAL_UART_Receive
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_UART_Receive(UART_HandleTypeDef *, uint8_t *data, uint16_t size, uint32_t timeout)

semantics.timeouts: bounded per-transfer timeout supplied by caller; value from reference call sites

facts.requirement: Use the fixed ToBudOS uart_polling polling instance uart2 (symbol huart2), passing the corresponding HAL handle pointer to the reference driver; retain the task-configured bus type and addressing conventions.

Provide blocking HAL_UART_Transmit and HAL_UART_Receive with UART_HandleTypeDef *, data buffers, uint16_t lengths, and per-call uint32_t timeouts; return status enables transfer-failure detection. The task fixes UART2/huart2 and 9600 8N1.
